_meta.note: Pending settings copy: daemon-unavailable states, credential strict-mode facts, 501 action reason, local UI switches. Every key below is also referenced as the 2nd argument of t() in apps/console-next/js/views/settings/*.js, so the UI stays readable before the merge. Merge with: node apps/console-next/i18n/tools/merge-pending.mjs (lead only).

en.settings.danger.collection-off: Every collection channel is being switched off: there will be no new events and no new alerts. An empty console then means “nothing is being collected”, not “nothing is happening”.
en.settings.offline.body: The local daemon is not reachable. Only interface preferences (theme, density, language) can be changed right now, and they stay local.
en.settings.offline.draft-kept: Your unsaved edits are kept; nothing was written.
en.settings.offline.group-body: Nothing in this group can be read or written until the daemon answers ({code}). No value was changed and no default was invented.
en.settings.offline.group-title: Unavailable: the local daemon is not running
en.settings.offline.local-ok: Applies locally without the daemon (stored in aidn.ui).
en.settings.offline.local-only-note: The daemon is not running, so these values are applied locally and stored in aidn.ui only. They will not reach settings.json until the daemon is reachable — this page does not pretend otherwise.
en.settings.offline.title: The local daemon is not running
en.settings.provider.strict-note: The host exposes this key in strict mode: only the mask, the length bucket and the timestamp are available. The console can prove that a key of this length was stored at that time — it cannot prove which key it is.
en.settings.provider.untested-hint: Never tested. A successful test is the only proof this provider can be reached — an untested provider is not a working one.
en.settings.ui.daemon-only-note: Tray behaviour and autostart live in settings.json and are not wired in 0.0.1. They stay untouched while the daemon is down.
en.settings.ui.start-view-unwired: Stored in aidn.ui, but the 0.0.1 shell ignores it: the console still opens on Overview.

zh-CN.settings.danger.collection-off: 所有采集通道都将被关闭：不再有新事件、也不再有新告警。此时界面一片安静，只代表「没有在采集」，不代表「没有事情发生」。
zh-CN.settings.offline.body: 连不上本机守护进程。目前只有界面偏好（主题、密度、语言）还能改，并且只保存在本地。
zh-CN.settings.offline.draft-kept: 未保存的修改已保留，但什么都没写入。
zh-CN.settings.offline.group-body: 在守护进程应答之前，本组的内容既读不到也写不进（{code}）。没有改动任何值，也没有编造默认值。
zh-CN.settings.offline.group-title: 不可用：本机守护进程未运行
zh-CN.settings.offline.local-ok: 不需要守护进程，本地立即生效（写入 aidn.ui）。
zh-CN.settings.offline.local-only-note: 守护进程未运行，因此这些值只在本地生效并写入 aidn.ui。要等守护进程可用后才会写进 settings.json —— 本页不会假装已经保存。
zh-CN.settings.offline.title: 本机守护进程未运行
zh-CN.settings.provider.strict-note: 主机以严格模式暴露此密钥：只提供掩码、长度区间与更新时间。控制台能证明「在那个时间存过一把这个长度的钥匙」，但无法证明是哪一把。
zh-CN.settings.provider.untested-hint: 从未测试。只有测试成功才能证明这个提供方可用 —— 没测过不等于可用。
zh-CN.settings.ui.daemon-only-note: 托盘行为与开机自启存放在 settings.json，且在 0.0.1 未接线。守护进程不可用期间它们保持原样。
zh-CN.settings.ui.not-applied: 已在本地生效：{applied} · 未生效：{skipped}
zh-CN.settings.ui.start-view-unwired: 已写入 aidn.ui，但 0.0.1 的外壳不读取它：控制台仍会打开「概览」。
